personality_one_liner: A high-precision, technical creative studio leveraging sharp alignments, oversized grotesk typography, and stark monochrome surfaces punctuated by signal red to frame AI-generated art.

spacing.rule: Exposed spacing systems, edge-to-edge grids, structural dividers. 0 spacing around full-bleed canvases. Hard padding for forms.

do's: Use solid surfaceSecondary or borderStrong dividers for overlays
Rely on hard 2pt borders to establish depth and hierarchy

screens.name: Home / Studio Hub
screens.purpose: The command center linking to the 5 creation modes and recent gallery.

states.loading: Centered monospace 'LOADING STUDIO_ENV...' with a stark linear progress bar.
states.empty: No recent renders. 'AWAITING INPUT' in large mono text.
states.error: Signal red block with white mono text detailing connection failure to LLM.

screens.layout: Rigid edge-to-edge grid. Top: oversized 'LEO.AI' header with Google Profile block. Middle: 5 Mode cards stacked or in a tight grid. Cards have hard black 2pt borders (`borderStrong`), monochrome base, with high-contrast icons. Bottom: 'RECENT EXPORTS' horizontally scrolling strip with flush images (contact-sheet style).

screens.name: AI Prompt Composer Overlay
screens.purpose: Technical prompt interface for user text entry and LLM engine selection.

states.loading: Signal red pulse animation on the GENERATE button.
states.empty: Input area blank, waiting for prompt.
states.error: Error toast inline above the input area with hard red border.

screens.layout: Bottom sheet or full-screen modal with 0 radius. JetBrains Mono used for text entry. A structural segmented control for Model Picker (Claude / GPT-5.2 / Gemini 3 Pro) with active state as black background / white text. Full-width Signal Red primary CTA button pinned at bottom.

screens.name: 3D Video Timeline Sequencer
screens.purpose: Timeline-based sequencer chaining scenes into video.

states.empty: Timeline empty, prompt to add first scene.

screens.layout: Upper 50% is the preview canvas. Lower 50% is the horizontal timeline. Timeline ruler displays short format (<1min) with dots for subdivisions using JetBrains Mono. Tracks are horizontal rows with hard borders. The playhead is a highly visible vertical Signal Red line (`brandPrimary`) cutting through the tracks. Track selection uses strong black outlines.

screens.name: Gallery / Contact Sheet
screens.layout: Dense 2 or 3 column grid with zero gaps (0 spacing). Hard 1pt black borders separating images. Tapping opens a full-screen viewer with a stark metadata overlay at the bottom (Prompt, Date, Engine) in JetBrains Mono text with a solid black backdrop (no glass).

scene_mode_bg.alt: Intricate wireframe with dynamic ribbons in an abstract 3D composition

video_mode_bg.alt: Vibrant 3D abstract geometric pattern with yellow, violet, and white blocks

text_video_bg.alt: Bold yellow text EVERYTHING COUNTS on a black background

audio_visualizer_bg.alt: Abstract image of red and blue waves

svg_art_bg.alt: Blue and white polka dot abstract SVG style textile

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Brutalist Mobile LIGHT personality. Do NOT use gradients, rounded corners, or shadows. Everything must be 0-radius and flat.
Use JetBrains Mono for all metadata, labels, model pickers, and timeline timestamps. Use Space Grotesk for large display headers.
Borders are a crucial structural element. Use borderStrong (1.5pt-2pt) to delineate cards, timeline tracks, and input fields.
The UI should feel like a technical command center, not a consumer social app.
For the timeline sequencer, implement a horizontal scrollable ruler with a static Playhead in the center, or a moving Playhead line in Signal Red.
Ensure 'AI Prompt Composer' model picker (Claude/GPT-5.2/Gemini) uses a hard, blocky segmented control design.
Gallery must be a zero-gap 'contact sheet' grid with hard borders separating the imagery.
All CTA buttons (like Generate) should be full-bleed or hard rectangular blocks, utilizing the Signal Red brand color.
Do NOT use indigo, blue, or purple anywhere in the system UI. The aesthetic must rely on monochrome (white/black/grey) + Signal Red.
